card.name: All-caps warning text: INCLUDING and IN
card.fires_on: Capitalized words in all-caps boxed warnings, mainly INCLUDING after 'emergency measures,' and IN after 'trained'. Also fires on the word EMERGENCY in the same hypersensitivity sentence.

modes.label: INCLUDING in anaphylaxis warning
modes.description: The word INCLUDING after 'other emergency measures,' in the all-caps hypersensitivity warning.
modes.example: ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMERGENCY MEASURES,<< INCLUDING>> OXYGEN, IV FLUIDS

modes.label: IN after trained
modes.description: The word IN after 'persons trained' in an all-caps warning about who may give an anesthetic.
modes.example: WARNINGS INTRAVENOUS ETOMIDATE SHOULD BE ADMINISTERED ONLY BY PERSONS TRAINED<< IN>> THE ADMINISTRATION OF GENERAL ANESTH

modes.label: EMERGENCY in same warning
modes.description: The middle of the word EMERGENCY, just before 'MEASURES, INCLUDING'.
modes.example: DRUG. SERIOUS ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS MAY REQUIRE TREATMENT WITH EPINEPHRINE AND OTHER EMER<<GENCY>> MEASURES, INCLUDING OXYGEN

card.writes: It pushes up small linking words like in, for, on, from and of, and pushes down odd variants of them.
card.plain: It marks all-caps warning text where a small linking word like 'including' or 'in' comes next.
